BIRTH ABROAD? (post for friend)
🤑ISO: women who have given birth abroad 🙏

1 What happened with maternity pay on A5? 

2 What documents were needed for the Israeli Embassy? How long did it take? 

3 How long before you could return to Israel (practically and in terms of health)?

4 Any other advice? 

Friend is willing to pay to have someone walk her through the process. Pm if interested. Free advice of course welcome too 😊
